25// Convenience overloads of @ref AddToScene that delegate to the canonical overloads using default
26// @ref PrefabParams. Declared in mochi_prefab.h.
27inline AddToSceneResult AddToScene(ScenePrefab const& prefab, Scene* scene, Error& error) {
28 return AddToScene(prefab, scene, PrefabParams{}, error);
29}
30
31inline AddToSceneResult
32AddToScene(std::string_view prefabPath, std::string_view rootPath, Scene* scene, Error& error) {
33 return AddToScene(prefabPath, rootPath, scene, PrefabParams{}, error);
34}
